LanguageData.CC_GodSelene_Morning_Found: By {PAWN}'s bed this morning: {THING}. Nobody in the colony owns it, and nobody brought it in the night.
LanguageData.CC_GodSelene_Morning_GoodDream: {PAWN} woke this morning from a dream of a silver road, smiling, and has told it to anyone who would listen.
LanguageData.CC_GodSelene_Morning_Healed: {PAWN}'s worst wound closed in the night, as if days had passed instead of hours.
LanguageData.CC_GodSelene_Morning_Nightmare: {PAWN} woke shaking from a dream about what {PAWN_pronoun} did yesterday, and won't talk about it.
LanguageData.CC_GodSelene_Morning_Frost: Frost lay this morning all about the place where {PAWN} sleeps, and nowhere else.
LanguageData.CC_GodSelene_Morning_AnimalBack: An animal stood at {PAWN}'s door at dawn, looking in, and wouldn't go away.
LanguageData.CC_GodSelene_Water_Text: At the full of the moon, {PAWN} found the moon lying in the still water by the colony, bright as a face, though the moon itself was behind {PAWN_objective}. {PAWN_pronoun} stood at the water's edge a long while.
LanguageData.CC_GodSelene_Saw_Water: {WHO} saw the full moon lying in the still water at {HOME}, though the moon was behind them, and stood by it a long while.
LanguageData.CC_GodSelene_Watch_Text: The moonlight is keeping {PAWN} company on {PAWN_possessive} watch tonight: {PAWN_pronoun} sees further than the night should allow, and {PAWN_possessive} aim is steadier.
LanguageData.CC_GodSelene_Saw_Watch: {WHO} kept the night out of doors at {HOME} with the moonlight about them like company.
LanguageData.CC_GodSelene_DarkFace_Text: There was no moon, so {PAWN} kept the night at the door until the small hours, looking out.
LanguageData.CC_GodSelene_Saw_DarkFace: {WHO} kept the door at {HOME} on a night with no moon.
